greeting.text: Mmm... a new face. Come closer, sweetie, I don't bite. I'm Vanessa. Don't mind the bottle, it's medicinal.
Well, well. Fresh blood for the labyrinth. Vanessa Enoteca, at your service, {player}. Buy a girl a drink sometime.
Oh, you've got a thread on you. A bright one, too. Interesting. Name's Vanessa, cutie.
You've been out there a while, haven't you? There's blood in your threads. Sit, drink some water. I'm Vanessa.
Mm, you dealt with Heath Grice. That's why I woke up. I'm Vanessa. Pour yourself something and tell me about it.

hint.text: A little advice from a lazy woman: don't rush. The labyrinth isn't going anywhere. Rest in a Landing, drink some water, and live to see the second floor.
Don't go alone, sweetie. Every thread needs another end. The dungeon keeps one set of floors per party, so the people you bring are the only ones you'll see down there.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun is a knot of old grudges. Heath Grice, Vetto and the rest sit at the tangles. Pull at the right one and the whole thing loosens.
Further down there's a devil who talks things into being. Zagred. I can't read his thread; words don't have one. Keep your own tied tight when you go in.
Three brothers, three devils: gravity, curses, space. I'd stay far away from the one with the curses. A curse is just a thread someone tied around you without asking.
I'm told Lucius has two souls on one thread. Rude. I'd need a very strong drink to read that one.
Seven strangers named for sins. Even the thread around them hums. It's a different weave from ours, as if it came off another loom.
In that other dungeon the threads all run one way: down. Be careful what you follow, sweetie.
Twenty fights and you're still smiling? Lovely. Come sit, I'll buy the first round. Er. You'll buy it, I'll drink it.

Red Thread holds an ordinary enemy for about three seconds from sixteen blocks away, and a boss for one. Bind the same target again within half a minute and it holds half as long. Plan around that, sweetie.
Rouge watches over you for a day. If a blow would kill you, she ties your thread back to where you stood a few seconds ago, at half health. Once a day. Don't waste her.
Arresting Dark Weave, Thread Trap and the Reinforcement that turns mana into a second skin only open in my own grimoire. A borrowed book won't oblige. Threads are picky.
Curses are threads someone tied around you. Don't yank on them. Find the knot, ask nicely, and if the knot says no... then pull.
Heath Grice. Poor man; he tied himself in his own knot. You cut it clean, sweetie. I'm impressed.
You beat Zagred? A devil that speaks reality? Come here, I want to look at your thread. ...Still there. Good. You're a lucky one.
The whole Dark Triad? Ooh, that calls for a night of drinking. Sit.
Two souls, one body, and you cut the knot. Take your time, sweetie. You've earned a nap.
I'm not lazy. I'm conserving energy for important things, like sleeping, and flirting with the captain.
The captain never notices. Or maybe he does and he's too embarrassed to say. Either way, it's adorable.
Noelle's a sweet girl, but she needs to relax. Asta needs to relax even more. Honestly, everyone needs a drink.
Fate isn't a straight line, {player}. It's a tangle. You can pull it, cut it, braid it... just don't tie it to yourself.
Mmm. Do you smell that? Charmy's cooking. Follow your nose. That's an order. From a drunk witch.
The beds in the corridors are for show, honey. Real rest is in a Landing or a safe room. I checked every single one.
There's no easy healing down there. The dungeon doesn't let you just regenerate. So bring potions, or bring me. I accept payment in alcohol.

farewell.text: Go on, sweetie. Come back and tell me everything.
Mmm... leaving so soon? Fine. I'll drink to your safe return.
Fate willing, we'll meet again. And if not... I'll have a drink in your name.
